description: Search the Global LEI Index by company name or LEI code: LEI, name, LEI status, address, legal form code, creation date, category, jurisdiction, registration dates and managing issuer. Filter by active or inactive LEI, exact LEI status, entity category and country. 1 point per returned record.

category.description: Entity category. Options: GENERAL = General, FUND = Fund, BRANCH = Branch, SOLE_PROPRIETOR = Sole proprietor, INTERNATIONAL_ORGANIZATION = International organization, RESPONSIBLE_ENTITY = Responsible entity

keyword.description: Company name or LEI. e.g. Apple

reg_status.description: LEI status (exact). Options: ISSUED = Issued, LAPSED = Lapsed, ANNULLED = Annulled, RETIRED = Retired, MERGED = Merged, DUPLICATE = Duplicate, PENDING_TRANSFER = Pending transfer, PENDING_ARCHIVAL = Pending archival, PENDING_NAME_TRANSFER = Pending name transfer, PENDING_NAME_TRANSFER_MERGER = Pending name transfer (merger), PENDING_VALIDATION = Pending validation

status.description: Active or inactive LEI. Options: active = Active, inactive = Inactive / dissolved

name: run_gleif_companies_search
